notes.title: Version 1.2 Is Out
notes.content:
Updates:
- Fixed bug where game over music did not play
- Added Settings options to use arrow keys for movement
- Fixed rare apple spawning bug where apples would repeatedly spawn in a set location
- Added button to exit to desktop
- Added button to delete save file at any time
- General stability improvements

notes.title: Update Notes for October 24, 2022
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where window resizing wasn't possible.
